title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity bump v1.149.0
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth, retry behaviour, and streaming ergonomics while introducing a minor ergonomic surface for developers. This PR consolidates the auth adapter, standardizes retry/backoff defaults across SDKs, improves streaming iterator ergonomics, and bumps SDK package versions to v1.149.0.

What this PR does (summary): - Add a unified AuthAdapter interface and implementations for API key / OAuth token refresh flows across all SDKs. - Standardize retryable error classification and default retry/backoff parameters (idempotent vs non-idempotent paths). - Add streaming helpers: typed async iterators (TS/Py) and channel-friendly interfaces (Go) to simplify consumer code. - Fix parity gaps in method names and options (timeout vs deadline, max_retries -> retries). - Update docs and changelogs; add compatibility tests.

Checklist: - [x] Python: auth adapter + retry middleware + streaming iterator - [x] TypeScript: auth plugin + retry wrapper + readable stream wrapper - [x] Go: auth transport + retry interceptor + stream client helper - [x] E2E parity tests updated and passing - [x] Changelog + release notes updated - [x] Version bumps for all SDK packages to v1.149.0

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps default retry counts conservative to avoid masking user errors (see ENG-1423). Token refresh is non-blocking for streaming reads where possible to avoid head-of-line stalls. Related: ENG-1423 (retry policy alignment), ENG-1530 (streaming ergonomics), SUP-4421 (customer-reported auth edge case).
commits: python: add AuthAdapter, TokenRefresher, and RetryMiddleware; wire into ClientImpl
typescript: introduce AuthPlugin interface and default RetryWrapper; add StreamReader helper
go: add transport.RoundTripper auth wrapper and RetryInterceptor; add StreamClient helper
tests: add cross-sdk parity e2e tests for auth/retries/streaming
docs: update SDK README sections for auth and streaming ergonomics
chore: bump python/ts/go packages to v1.149.0; update changelogs
changed_files: go.mod: bump go sdk module to v1.149.0
review_comments: Alex Kim: Overall looks good. Please ensure retry defaults are documented prominently — ops teams will want to tune these. Also call out non-idempotent path behaviour in changelog.
Priya Natarajan (author): Added a dedicated section in docs/sdks/auth.md and updated changelogs to call out idempotent vs non-idempotent defaults.
Diego Martinez: Found a race in Go token refresh during streaming - added a suggestion to serialize refreshes per-connection. Can we limit refresh concurrency?
Priya Natarajan (author): Addressed race by moving token refresh into a singleflight-like guard in go/internal/auth/transport.go and added unit tests around concurrent stream reads.
Claire Zhou: TypeScript streaming API ergonomic name nit: prefer `stream.readLines()` over `stream.iterator()` for readability. Minor but impacts discoverability.
Priya Natarajan (author): Renamed wrapper to `readLines()` and left a deprecated alias for one release with console deprecation warning.
merge_commit_message:
sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity bump v1.149.0

Consolidate auth adapters, standardize retry defaults, improve streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go and bump packages to v1.149.0.
release_notes: SDKs: v1.149.0 release - unified auth adapter across Python/TypeScript/Go
SDKs: standardized retry/backoff defaults and clearer idempotency rules
SDKs: improved streaming ergonomics (Py async iterator, TS readLines(), Go stream helper)
Docs: updated auth and streaming guides; compatibility notes added
Bugfix: fix token refresh race in Go streaming client
notes_for_backport: No backports required for older minor releases. If requested, cherry-pick auth adapter changes only and keep default retry settings conservative.
testing_instructions: Run `./scripts/sdk_e2e_parity.sh` which runs auth/retry/streaming scenarios across local dockerized inference endpoints. Validate streaming example apps in sdks/*/examples/streaming. Observe token refresh under long-lived streams.
